_comment: Speech lines by situation and language. {name} is the pet's name; the user is 'sen' (vi) / 'human' (en). A line may be a string or {"text": ..., "personality": ["Playful", "Calm", "Curious", "Balanced"]} to limit it to those profiles. Keep lines short (under 60 characters). Restart the AI after editing; publish again to update the standalone copy.
